title: 3 killed in US Idaho shopping area shooting; gunman among dead
summary_full: Three people died and two were injured after a gunman opened fire. The shooter was also among the deceased, with authorities investigating the motive. The chaotic scene unfolded near a busy In-N-Out Burger restaurant on Saturday afternoon. Witnesses described seeing an armed individual and people fleeing the area in fear. Law enforcement confirmed the threat to the community was over after the incident.
